Markets Daily: Quiet Trading Ahead of Holiday

Trading volumes thinned across major exchanges on Tuesday as institutional desks closed positions ahead of the long holiday weekend, leaving smaller retail flows to set the tone for an otherwise muted session that finished mixed across sectors.

Energy shares led modest gains as crude oil firmed on supply concerns, while consumer staples drifted lower after a major retailer trimmed its full-year guidance and warned that promotional pressure would continue into the autumn quarter.

Bond markets were equally subdued, with the ten-year yield holding within a narrow range as traders awaited Friday's employment report. Strategists noted that any meaningful repricing was unlikely until liquidity returned next week.
